summary.text: Eric Wilson is the Republican candidate for the Georgia House of Representatives, District 145, in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia also lists Wilson as a Republican candidate in the special election for Georgia State Senate District 18, which he lost in the special general election on January 20, 2026; it says he did not appear on the Republican primary ballot for that seat on May 19, 2026.

sources.title: Georgia House of Representatives elections, 2026 - Ballotpedia
